name: Dora Bellmel
source:
The offspring of renowned demon summoner Karl Bellmel, she is orphaned as an infant and raised by two demons who serve her both as familiars and as surrogate parents. 

Although a skilled summoner with absolute confidence in her abilities, she is more comfortable with the company of demons than with humans. Her greatest wish is to find a way to live in the demon world of Acheron permanently, leaving the world of humans which she despairs of behind.

[Spoiler] The highest ranking member of the demon-worshipping society "Black Moon" (黒の月) in the locality, she is ordered to Ishgalia to secure material pertaining to the Chimera research which Demetrio Madram oversees. [/Spoiler]
